t: Robust, powerful inspection light with spot and flood light options for precise illumination even in the largest of work areas. Ideal addition for any tool box belonging to a trade professional. Can be flexibly positioned and aligned at any time due to integrated magnet and hook in the stand. Powerful battery can be easily recharged via USB and can be replaced if necessary. Also includes a transport lock, a metal screw for tightening the foldable stand and a nubbed surface for a strong grip.
b: With Magnet & Hook for Hands-Free Working
